title: Hunger of the Constant
description: The food from the Don't Starve series, in Minecraft! Prepare food in a Crock Pot and come across new resources in the wild.
body:
The food from the Don't Starve series, in Minecraft! Prepare food in a Crock Pot
and come across new resources in the wild.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ppTPuRdYdbs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![Mandrake Root](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ofkhPkrp/images/64edc2595ef0b7414009e364d4b19aec1dbbc6c2.png)

## Features

- Fully data-driven, custom cooking ingredients and recipes can be
  created/tweaked with datapacks.
- Obtain new resources from mob loot and world generation, new loot tables for
  vanilla entities that don't have any loot.
- Extend the hunger value of some food items or grant them status effects by 
  cooking them into prepared food items.
- Get 10% to 40% more saturation from prepared food items compared to vanilla 
  food items.
- Make food for no fuel, for the cost of longer cooking times.
- Mix inedible items into edible food.
- Identical cooking system & recipes to that of Don't Starve.
- Act like these games actually did a crossover.

![Mod Content](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ofkhPkrp/images/566a4f8a2f48367cd137d05825e158b33d6ba5d4.png)
